intro: A fuller fortnight of unusual experiences: experimental dance, mixed-media performances, new exhibition openings, unexpected music and meaningful last-chance visits. Owner-only editorial rehearsal, not a subscriber issue.
disclaimer: PRIVATE TEST-008. Organizer calendars and individual event pages reviewed 17 Nov 2026. Some prices and live inventories are unknown, not implied available. No subscriber distribution.

top3.title: En ljuvlighet från ingenstans — film and conversation

top3.description: Ester M. Bergsmark’s experimental 2026 film is followed by a Swedish-language conversation with Lina Selander. A free, one-off encounter between cinema, art and bodily experience.
